acceptanceCriteria: Features are computed from immutable Git history at the indexed revision and each contributing feature is named in the row reason.
CODEOWNERS/blame disagreement is reported as uncertainty, not resolved silently.
Measured on the frozen retrieval evaluation with the feature on and off.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: CODEOWNERS is parsed but there is no blame, recency or ownership-decay feature, and the cochange slot uses a flat 200-commit window. Add a recency feature with a 90-day half-life over Git history, a blame-derived last-touch feature, and treat CODEOWNERS as drifting authority when blame disagrees. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md.
title: context: blame, recency and ownership-decay ranking features
